sloka: तेषाम् नृपो वचः श्रुत्वा कृत अंजलिः अभाषत ।विश्वामित्रम् महात्मानम् तौ उभौ राम लक्ष्मणौ ॥१-६७-७॥
transliteration: teṣām nṛpo vacaḥ śrutvā kṛta aṁjaliḥ abhāṣata ।viśvāmitram mahātmānam tau ubhau rāma lakṣmaṇau ॥1-67-7॥

translations.english: Having heard this, the king with folded hands said to the great soul Viswamitra sitting with the two princes Rama and Lakshmana:
